key_insight: Denoising diffusion models synthesize realistic metal additive-manufacturing microstructures and enable property-to-structure and process-to-structure inverse design.
engineering_relevance: AI-generated microstructures could support digital twins and computational workflows that accelerate AM materials qualification and certification.
method: Train denoising diffusion probabilistic models to generate orientation-imaging micrographs.
Use classifier-free guidance for property- and process-conditioned microstructure generation.
Demonstrate a qualification-relevant uncertainty quantification application.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports quantitative evidence of generated-sample fidelity but does not specify dataset size, evaluation metrics, or numerical results.
watch_item: Deployment requires validating generated microstructures and their predicted properties across relevant AM process conditions.
paper_title: Microstructural Generative Inverse Models for Additive Manufacturing Digital Twins
